name: Buzz
tagline: Self-hosted workspace and Nostr relay for humans and agents
description: Buzz is a self-hostable workspace for humans and agents from Block. It runs a Nostr relay, a REST bridge, git-over-object-storage, and a web interface from a single Rust binary, so you can host your own community and agent infrastructure.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Buzz s3 access key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Buzz s3 secret key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Buzz relay private key
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

questions.label: Postgres password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  relay:
    image: ghcr.io/block/buzz:main@sha256:4c608b727b29015a1d93eef750bfaf0d1bdd5841f92d6f99097e10a025e7e72b
    container_name: buzz-relay
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:3000"
    environment:
      BUZZ_BIND_ADDR: 0.0.0.0:3000
      BUZZ_HEALTH_PORT: "8080"
      BUZZ_METRICS_PORT: "9102"
      DATABASE_URL: postgres://buzz:${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}@postgres:5432/buzz
      REDIS_URL: redis://:change-me-redis-3Fn8pL5wZ6yB@redis:6379
      BUZZ_S3_ENDPOINT: http://minio:9000
      BUZZ_S3_ADDRESSING_STYLE: path
      BUZZ_S3_ACCESS_KEY: ${SECRET_BUZZ_S3_ACCESS_KEY}
      BUZZ_S3_SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_BUZZ_S3_SECRET_KEY}
      BUZZ_S3_BUCKET: buzz-media
      BUZZ_GIT_REPO_PATH: /data/git
      BUZZ_AUTO_MIGRATE: "true"
      BUZZ_GIT_CONFORMANCE_PROBE: "true"
      BUZZ_REQUIRE_AUTH_TOKEN: "true"
      BUZZ_REQUIRE_RELAY_MEMBERSHIP: "false"
      BUZZ_RELAY_PRIVATE_KEY: ${SECRET_BUZZ_RELAY_PRIVATE_KEY}
      BUZZ_SERVE_GIT_WEB_GUI: "true"
      RELAY_URL: ws://localhost:3000
      BUZZ_MEDIA_BASE_URL: http://localhost:3000/media
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/git_data:/data/git
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
      minio-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "bash -ec 'exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080; printf \"GET /_readiness HTTP/1.1\\r\\nHost: 127.0.0.1\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\" >&3; grep -q \"200 OK\" <&3'"]
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 30s
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - buzz_network
  postgres:
    image: postgres:17-alpine@sha256:742f40ea20b9ff2ff31db5458d127452988a2164df9e17441e191f3b72252193
    container_name: buzz-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: buzz
      POSTGRES_USER: buzz
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_POSTGRES_PASSWORD}
      PGDATA: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/postgres_data:/var/lib/postgresql/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "pg_isready -U $${POSTGRES_USER} -d $${POSTGRES_DB}"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - buzz_network
  redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine@sha256:e7723ff73d963f5cc6d9c4643ea3d989527a402a319239054e9472a7fb9219a2
    container_name: buzz-redis
    command: ["redis-server", "--appendonly", "yes", "--requirepass", "change-me-redis-3Fn8pL5wZ6yB"]
    environment:
      REDIS_PASSWORD: change-me-redis-3Fn8pL5wZ6yB
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/redis_data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD-SHELL", "redis-cli -a \"$${REDIS_PASSWORD}\" ping | grep -q PONG"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 3s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 5s
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - buzz_network
  minio:
    image: minio/minio:RELEASE.2025-09-07T16-13-09Z@sha256:14cea493d9a34af32f524e538b8346cf79f3321eff8e708c1e2960462bd8936e
    container_name: buzz-minio
    command: server /data --console-address ":9001"
    environment:
      MINIO_ROOT_USER: change-me-s3-access-J4hN7qX2
      MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD: ${SECRET_BUZZ_S3_SECRET_KEY}
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/minio_data:/data
    healthcheck:
      test: ["CMD", "curl", "-f", "http://127.0.0.1:9000/minio/health/live"]
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 10s
    restart: unless-stopped
    networks:
      - buzz_network
  minio-init:
    image: minio/mc:RELEASE.2025-08-13T08-35-41Z@sha256:a7fe349ef4bd8521fb8497f55c6042871b2ae640607cf99d9bede5e9bdf11727
    container_name: buzz-minio-init
    depends_on:
      minio:
        condition: service_healthy
    environment:
      BUZZ_S3_ACCESS_KEY: ${SECRET_BUZZ_S3_ACCESS_KEY}
      BUZZ_S3_SECRET_KEY: ${SECRET_BUZZ_S3_SECRET_KEY}
      BUZZ_S3_BUCKET: buzz-media
    entrypoint: >
      /bin/sh -euc '




























































































        mc alias set local http://minio:9000 "$${BUZZ_S3_ACCESS_KEY}" "$${BUZZ_S3_SECRET_KEY}"
        mc mb --ignore-existing "local/$${BUZZ_S3_BUCKET}"
        mc anonymous set none "local/$${BUZZ_S3_BUCKET}"
      '

    restart: "no"
    networks:
      - buzz_network
networks:
  buzz_network:
    driver: bridge
